CVE-2026-86776.title: KeePass versions 2.35 through 2.61.1 fail to validate KDBX header ...
CVE-2026-86776.description: KeePass versions 2.35 through 2.61.1 fail to validate KDBX header field sizes before memory allocation in the ReadHeaderField function. Attackers can craft a malicious KDBX file declaring excessive header field lengths to trigger allocation of gigabytes of memory, causing the application to consume resources and terminate.
